title: Implement note density estimator with ring buffer
description:
Create Source/Analysis/DensityEstimator.h and Source/Analysis/DensityEstimator.cpp ONLY.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Analysis/PerformanceAnalyzer.h (task g.2 — fixed 48000 Hz analysis rate and the analysis-sample clock this module counts in)
- Source/Analysis/AnalysisResampler.h (task g.1 — the analysisSampleRate constant)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; do NOT edit it)

Implement class DensityEstimator with prepare(), reset(), pushOnset (int64_t analysisSampleTimestamp), advance (int numAnalysisSamples), and const accessors getEventRate() and getDensity().

Storage: accepted onset timestamps are held in a fixed-size, real-time-safe ring buffer sized at compile time (use a std::array with capacity 64 onset slots — ample for the densest realistic playing inside the density window). The ring buffer is a plain member array; it is never resized and never heap-allocated. When the buffer is full, the oldest timestamp is overwritten; overflow is acceptable and must not allocate, throw, or block.

Required equations, exactly as specified and binding:
- The density window is a configurable duration with default 2.0 seconds, expressed internally in analysis samples at the fixed 48000 Hz rate (2.0 * 48000 = 96000 samples). It must NOT be derived from the host sample rate.
- eventRate = (number of onset timestamps inside the density window) / (density window duration in seconds).
- u = clamp((eventRate - densityStart) / (densityFull - densityStart), 0.0f, 1.0f), with defaults densityStart = 2.0 events/second and densityFull = 14.0 events/second, both settable.
- density = 3*u*u - 2*u*u*u (smoothstep). Guard against densityFull == densityStart by treating u as 0 in that degenerate case.

Density must rise monotonically with event rate: because smoothstep is monotone non-decreasing on [0,1] and u is monotone in eventRate, do not add any non-monotone shaping, hysteresis, or randomization.

Expiry: advance() increments the internal analysis-sample clock and drops timestamps older than the window by moving a tail index only — never by shifting or reallocating the array, and never with an unbounded loop over an unbounded range (bound the eviction loop by the fixed ring capacity).

Real-time rules restated and binding: no heap allocation, locks, file IO, string construction, GUI calls, buffer resizing, or unbounded loops in pushOnset, advance, or the accessors. All state is fixed-size member data. density and eventRate are continuous values; this module performs no technique classification. Do not introduce any new third-party dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Analysis/DensityEstimator.h and Source/Analysis/DensityEstimator.cpp exist and define class DensityEstimator with prepare, reset, pushOnset, advance, getEventRate, and getDensity members
Onset timestamps are stored in a fixed-capacity std::array-based ring buffer with no heap allocation and no resizing anywhere in the file
The density window is expressed in analysis samples at the fixed 48000 Hz analysis rate and does not depend on the host sample rate
eventRate is computed as the onset count inside the window divided by the window duration in seconds
u is computed as clamp((eventRate - densityStart)/(densityFull - densityStart), 0, 1) and density as 3*u*u - 2*u*u*u
No function in DensityEstimator.cpp calls new, malloc, resize, push_back, or any locking primitive
No file outside Source/Analysis/DensityEstimator.h and Source/Analysis/DensityEstimator.cpp is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any other file under Source/Analysis/
use std::vector, std::deque, or any dynamically sized container for onset timestamps
derive the density window from the host sample rate
add non-monotone shaping or hysteresis to the density mapping

allowed: choose private member names and ring-buffer index bookkeeping
choose whether timestamps are stored as int64_t sample counts or as a struct
add private helper methods inside DensityEstimator
forbidden: change the specified eventRate, u, or smoothstep density equations
change the default densityStart of 2.0 and densityFull of 14.0 without exposing them as settable members
allocate or resize storage at runtime
